Read the diagram: Nonblocking I/O leaves the event loop available for other eligible work.
Expected result: Reading prints before the file contents if the file read succeeds.

Interview question: Does nonblocking mean every operation runs in parallel?
Answer: No. The runtime delegates suitable I/O while JavaScript execution is scheduled.
